_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Crop Failure#001.dst: 嘖……那個沒良心的、滿口謊言、卑鄙無恥、偷雞摸狗的……啊啊啊！
Crop Failure#001.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#002.src: You! Help me out over here! You aren't doing anything important right now, and this is urgent!
Crop Failure#002.dst: 你！過來幫我一下！你沒在做什麼重要的事，而且這事可急了！
Crop Failure#002.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#003.src: I got a few questions for you, see? Question one: D'you think crops are supposed to look like THIS?
Crop Failure#003.dst: 我問你幾個問題，聽著啊？第一個：你覺得莊稼本來就該長成這鬼樣子嗎？
Crop Failure#003.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#004.src: Look at them. I don't think there's a way for 'em to look any more sorry than this.
Crop Failure#004.dst: 看看它們。我想它們也不可能再變的更慘了。
Crop Failure#004.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#005.src: Wha- You think the Oats over there look fine?! Pff. Yeah, right.
Crop Failure#005.dst: 什——你說那邊的 Oats 看起來沒問題？！哼。最好是這樣。
Crop Failure#005.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#006.src: If that's the case, go grab a scythe and try harvesting those Oats yourself!!
Crop Failure#006.dst: 既然你這麼說，那就拿把鐮刀，自己去把那些 Oats 收了啊！！
Crop Failure#006.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#007.src: Go on, do it! I dare you! See how good they really are!!
Crop Failure#007.dst: 去啊，動手啊！我倒要看看！看看它們到底有多好！！
Crop Failure#007.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#008.dst: 在 Anast 附近收集 [{~} Oats]

Crop Failure#009.src: See? What'd I tell ya? Rotten to the roots! Nothing here is ANY good!!
Crop Failure#009.dst: 看吧？我說什麼來著？根都爛了！這裡的東西沒一樣是好的！！
Crop Failure#009.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#010.src: They were growing pretty slow this year, all my crops, and then some salesman walks into town with some "MiracleCure" fertilizer.
Crop Failure#010.dst: 今年我所有的莊稼都長得特別慢，結果有個推銷員進了鎮，帶來了什麼「奇蹟肥料」。
Crop Failure#010.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#011.src: I shoulda known it was too good to be true, but he said everyone else tried it too, so I bought some and tried to salvage this mess.
Crop Failure#011.dst: 我早該知道這種好事不可能是真的，但他說大家都試過了，所以我就買了一些，試著把這爛攤子救回來。
Crop Failure#011.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#012.src: And here we are- me out half my savings and my fields as smelly and dead as an actual CORPSE!
Crop Failure#012.dst: 結果你看——我的積蓄少了一半，田地還臭得跟真正的屍體一樣！
Crop Failure#012.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#013.src: Just to prove this ridiculous phony Doubiss is a fraud- Here. I see some roots over here. Watch this, and tell me if this is a "miracle!"
Crop Failure#013.dst: 只為了證明那個叫 Doubiss 的荒唐騙子就是個騙子——來。這邊有些根，你看好後告訴我這到底算不算「奇蹟」！
Crop Failure#013.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#014.src: Here we go, here comes the big phenomenal growth he promised me!
Crop Failure#014.dst: 來了來了——這就是他向我保證的非凡的生長速度！
Crop Failure#014.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#015.src: WOW, INCREDIBLE! AMAZING! It's almost like this is actual poison or something!!
Crop Failure#015.dst: 哇！不可思議！太驚人了！這簡直就像真正的毒藥一樣！！
Crop Failure#015.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#016.src: That Doubiss won't budge for my refund. I spent... so many emeralds... on this tripe! So that's where YOU come in.
Crop Failure#016.dst: Doubiss 死活都不肯退錢。我可是花了……那麼多綠寶石……買這堆垃圾！所以你就派上用場了。
Crop Failure#016.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#017.src: He's in that blue and gray tent by the bank. I don't care how you do it, but get my money back and we'll split it half-and-half, deal?
Crop Failure#017.dst: 他就在銀行旁邊那頂藍灰色的帳篷裡。我不管你用什麼方法，總之把我的錢拿回來，我們一人一半，成交？
Crop Failure#017.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#018.src: Find Doubiss the salesman in {p} near the bank at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Crop Failure#018.dst: 在 {p} 銀行附近的 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找到推銷員 Doubiss。

Crop Failure#019.src: Good day to ya! What is it ye be needin' from ol' Doubiss' stock?
Crop Failure#019.dst: 日安啊！想從老 Doubiss 的貨裡買點什麼呀？
Crop Failure#019.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#020.src: Oh. Oh, goodie. That idiot farmer's sendin' ya to get his money back, ain't he? Sweet baby bovine, this is ridiculous...
Crop Failure#020.dst: 哦。哦，原來如此。那個蠢農夫派你來要回他的錢，是吧？天啊，這也太荒唐了……
Crop Failure#020.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#021.src: Since he obviously ain't gonna be listenin' to me anytime soon, lemme tell ya what the issue is with my fertilizer...
Crop Failure#021.dst: 既然他現在也不會想聽我的解釋，那我就跟你說說我的肥料到底有什麼問題吧……
Crop Failure#021.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#022.src: Nothing! My fertilizer really does work! He probl'ly exaggerated how good I said it'd work, too! What'd he say, twice, three times the growth? More?
Crop Failure#022.dst: 沒問題！我的肥料真的有效！搞不好是他把我說的效果誇大了！他說什麼？兩倍、三倍的生長速度？還是更多？
Crop Failure#022.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#023.src: All the other farmers are usin' it right now and look at their fields! Heck, the only reason these crops ain't dead is because of my product!
Crop Failure#023.dst: 其他農夫現在都在用，看看他們的田！哼，要不是有我的產品，這些莊稼早就死光了！
Crop Failure#023.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#024.src: Y'know why? Next time ya' pass a farm, take a good whiff o' the water, maybe a sip or two if you can manage. It'll be smelly and bitter.
Crop Failure#024.dst: 你知道為什麼嗎？下次經過農場時，好好聞聞水的味道，能的話喝上一兩口。那水又臭又苦。
Crop Failure#024.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#025.src: The crops, when I got here, were lookin' as pathetic as ya get. I ain't a gamblin' man, but I'd be willing ta bet something's up with the water here.
Crop Failure#025.dst: 我剛來這裡的時候，那些莊稼已經慘得不能再慘了。我雖然不是個愛賭的人，但我敢打賭，這裡的水肯定有問題。
Crop Failure#025.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#026.src: The smell gets worse the closer ya get to the crypts in town, and while I ain't a native Oluxer, I've heard enough to know the wellspring is in the cave hear there.
Crop Failure#026.dst: 越靠近鎮上的墓穴，味道就越重。而且我雖然不是 Olux 本地人，但也聽過一些消息，知道那附近的洞穴裡有個水源。
Crop Failure#026.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#027.src: It'll prob'ly be best fer everyone if ya took a looksee. Maybe if ya find some evidence, ya can show that to the crazy farmer, have 'im quit pesterin' me, eh?
Crop Failure#027.dst: 你最好去看看，這對大家都有好處。說不定你能找到什麼證據，拿給那個瘋農夫看，讓他別再來煩我，怎麼樣？
Crop Failure#027.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#028.src: The cave is on a little hill, next to the crypt. Careful ya don't go trippin' over a gravestone, now!
Crop Failure#028.dst: 那個洞穴就在一座小山丘上的墓穴旁邊。小心點，可別被墓碑絆倒了啊！
Crop Failure#028.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#029.src: Search the aquifer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the problem with the water.
Crop Failure#029.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的地下水層尋找水源污染的原因。

Crop Failure#030.src: Oi, bucko! Took my advice, eh? I'd figured I'd join ye, 'n see for myself what was goin' on.
Crop Failure#030.dst: 喂，小夥子！聽我的建議啦？我想說跟你一起來看看，親自瞧瞧到底出了什麼事。
Crop Failure#030.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#031.src: And boy am I glad I bring me water in bottles. This stuff's rancid, full a' swamp slimes. No idea why they're here, though.
Crop Failure#031.dst: 哎呀，我真慶幸自己帶的是瓶裝水。這水可真夠噁心的，裡面全是沼澤史萊姆。我也不知道牠們怎麼會跑到這裡來。
Crop Failure#031.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#032.src: The buggers stick to mountain caves. They don't come down this far, usually... suppose there's an exception fer everything.
Crop Failure#032.dst: 這些鬼東西平常都待在山上的洞穴裡，可不會跑到這麼深的地方來……不過嘛，什麼事都有例外。
Crop Failure#032.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#033.src: 's no wonder that Anast's crops ain't growin'. This is right under his farm! But we got some clear proof now, ain't we?
Crop Failure#033.dst: 難怪 Anast 的莊稼長不出來。這地方就在他的農場正下方！不過現在我們可是有明確的證據了，對吧？
Crop Failure#033.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#034.src: Howzabout ya take care o' this? I ain't a fighter, but if ya mulch these slimes the water oughta clear up, I figure.
Crop Failure#034.dst: 這個就交給你處理，怎麼樣？我不會打架，不過我想，只要你把這些史萊姆剁碎，水應該就會變乾淨了。
Crop Failure#034.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#035.src: Kill the slimes in the aquifer and bring back [Polluted Slime] to Anast.
Crop Failure#035.dst: 消滅地下水層中的史萊姆，並將 [受污染的史萊姆] 帶回給 Anast。

Crop Failure#036.src: Pyyyyeww! Yeesh, kid! You smell worse than a pig's sty! What the heck happened to you, where've you been?!
Crop Failure#036.dst: 呸——！噁！小子！你聞起來比豬圈還臭！你到底怎麼搞的？跑哪兒去了？！
Crop Failure#036.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#037.src: Ugh, eww! I don't want any of this sludge! I demand an explanation, now!!
Crop Failure#037.dst: 呃，噁！我才不要這些爛泥！現在就給我一個解釋！！
Crop Failure#037.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#038.src: ...mhm, mhm...you went into the well cave...and found what, slimes?! Why would SLIMES be there?
Crop Failure#038.dst: ……嗯，嗯……你進了洞穴……然後發現了什麼，史萊姆？！史萊姆為什麼會在那裡？！
Crop Failure#038.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#039.src: I wouldn't believe you if you weren't... well, uh... covered in the stuff. But that's definitely rancid.
Crop Failure#039.dst: 要不是你……呃……整個人都沾滿這些東西，我才不會相信你。但這東西確實臭得要命。
Crop Failure#039.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#040.src: So... that means I've been... oh dear lord I'm an idiot.
Crop Failure#040.dst: 所以……這代表我一直都……天啊，我真是個白痴。
Crop Failure#040.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#041.src: I guess I owe you some thanks anyway for trying to clear the sludge out. Suppose this year's harvest is just a bust.
Crop Failure#041.dst: 不管怎麼說，你至少也幫忙清掉了那些爛泥，我還是得謝謝你。今年的收成看來是徹底泡在臭湯裡了。
Crop Failure#041.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#042.src: Can't sell what little I have, so I figure you can take it, and a bit of cash too, since you basically did an exterminator's job.
Crop Failure#042.dst: 我這點收成也賣不出去，所以你就拿去吧，再給你一點現金。畢竟你基本上替我幹了除蟲公司的活。
Crop Failure#042.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#043.src: Just... do me a favor and use that money to buy some good soap and wash up. I'm thankful and all, but you stink to high heaven!
Crop Failure#043.dst: 只是……幫我個忙，拿那些錢去買點好一點的肥皂，好好洗個澡。雖然我是很感謝你啦，但你真的臭到熏天了！
Crop Failure#043.speaker: Anast
